ff-ballistics-deep-dive-2.front: Why does the bullet cross the line of sight twice?
ff-ballistics-deep-dive-2.back: The scope sits above the bore, so the bore tilts up. The bullet climbs through the line, then falls back through it at the zero.

ff-ballistics-deep-dive-5.front: 250 m hold on a 100 m zero in MOA?
ff-ballistics-deep-dive-5.back: About 3.8 MOA, about 15 clicks of 1/4 MOA, about 1.1 mil.
